To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reaction of acetylacetone with vinylacetylenes in the presence of Mn(OAc)3 and Cu(OAc)2 in MeOH leads to the formation of furan and dihydrotetrahydropyran derivatives, and the ratio of the two types of products depends on the structure of vinylacetylene.

the reaction of acetylenic dienes with acetoacetic acid ethyl ester in the presence of a manganese acetate/cupric acetate oxidative system proceeds with formation of 4, 5-dihydrofurans with a regiochemistry that depends on the nature of the acetylenic double bond.
4,5-di-hydrofurans were obtained by the reaction of conjugated acetoacetic acid esters with acetylene derivatives.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of 4, 5-dihydrofurans by the reaction of conjugated alkenyne with acetoacetic acid ethyl ester and the study of the regioselectivity of the reaction.
the synthesis of 4, 5-dihydrofurans by the reaction of alkyne derivatives with acetoacetic and ethylacetoacetic esters.
the development of new methods for the synthesis of 4, 5-dihydrofurans.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

4,5-di-hydrofuran derivatives can be synthesized by the reaction of conjugated acetylenes with acetoacetic acid esters in the presence of a catalyst system consisting of manganese acetate and copper acetate.
the regiochemistry of this reaction is determined by the presence in the molecule of a vinyl group in the α position relative to the acetoacetic group.
the regiochemistry of oxidative cyclization in the reaction of acetylene derivatives and acetoacetic acid esters depends on the structure of the starting compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method for the synthesis of 4, 5-dihydrofurans by the reaction of conjugated acetoacetic alkenynes with the oxidative system of manganese acetate/cuprous acetate.

the reaction of the acetoacetic and malonic esters with alkenynes in the presence of manganese acetate/cupric acetate oxidative system leads to the formation of furan, dihydrofuran and dihydropyran derivatives.

1,3-dipolar cycloaddition of 1,3-azadienes with alkenynes, catalyzed by copper salts, is an efficient method for synthesis of substituted 2,3-dihydrofuro[3,4-b]indoles and 3,4-dihydrofuron[2,3-b]indoles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reaction of acetic ester with alkenynes in the presence of manganese(III) acetate/copper(II) acetate is a promising method for the synthesis of derivatives of furan and its analogs.
4,5- dihydrofuran derivatives can be obtained by the reaction of conjugated alkenyne with acetoacetic acid esters in the presence of manganese and copper acetates.
acetoacetic acid esters react with alkenynes in the presence of a manganese/copper system, which is a convenient and simple way to obtain furan and 5,6-dihydrofuro[3,2-c]pyridine derivatives.
